name: rayfold-apps
description: A fleet of Rayfold microservices and the micro-frontends that use them, built the way a real team would.

scripts.schema:check: rayfold check services/documents/src/documents.rayfold --against services/documents/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/workspace/src/workspace.rayfold --against services/workspace/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold check services/catalogue/src/catalogue.rayfold --against services/catalogue/rayfold.lock.json
scripts.schema:lock: rayfold lock services/documents/src/documents.rayfold --out services/documents/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/workspace/src/workspace.rayfold --out services/workspace/rayfold.lock.json && rayfold lock services/catalogue/src/catalogue.rayfold --out services/catalogue/rayfold.lock.json
